operations.acceptOrgInvite: Accept this invitation to join a shared space.
operations.addCustomIntegration: Add an outside app of your own from a link.
operations.addOrgMember: Invite someone to this space with the role you chose.
operations.cancelRoutineRun: Stop this routine run while it is under way.
operations.createCheckout: Start the checkout that subscribes this workspace to a paid plan.
operations.createOrg: Create a shared space you can invite teammates into.
operations.createRoutine: Create a routine so the agent repeats work on a schedule.
operations.createSharedSkill: Create a skill and share it with everyone in the workspace.
operations.createSkill: Create a skill the agent can follow.
operations.declineOrgInvite: Decline this invitation to join a shared space.
operations.deleteActivity: Delete this mission from the agent's board.
operations.deleteAgent: Delete this agent and everything in it. This cannot be undone.
operations.deleteFile: Delete this file from the agent's workspace for good.
operations.deleteOrg: Delete this shared space and everything inside it. This cannot be undone.
operations.deleteOrgInvite: Cancel this pending invitation to the space.
operations.deleteRoutine: Delete this routine so it stops running on its schedule.
operations.deleteSharedSkill: Delete a skill shared with the workspace, removing it for everyone.
operations.deleteSkill: Delete this skill so the agent no longer has it.
operations.detectCustomIntegration: Check what kind of service this link points to.
operations.forgetCredential: Sign this workspace out of the AI account.
operations.getTunnelCredentials: Get the credentials that link a local AI model to a cloud agent.
operations.installAgentFromGithub: Install an agent from a GitHub repository.
operations.installCommunitySkill: Install a skill from the community directory into the agent.
operations.installSkillsFromRepo: Install skills from a GitHub repository into the agent.
operations.joinAgentTeam: Join this team in the space.
operations.mintRoutineWebhookKey: Create a fresh key that lets an outside service start this routine. Any key issued before stops working.
operations.moveAgent: Move this agent into a shared space so teammates can work with it.
operations.moveProjectFile: Move this file into another folder of the agent's workspace.
operations.promoteSharedSkill: Share the agent's skill with everyone in the workspace.
operations.pushClaudeOAuthCredential: Send this computer's Claude sign-in to a cloud agent.
operations.putSkillsManifest: Choose which of the agent's skills are switched on.
operations.removeAgentTeamMember: Remove this person from the team.
operations.removeCustomIntegration: Remove an outside app you added yourself.
operations.removeOrgMember: Remove this person from the space.
operations.renameFile: Rename this file in the agent's workspace.
operations.revokeApiKey: Revoke this API key for good. Anything still using it stops working.
operations.runRoutineNow: Run this routine right now instead of waiting for its next scheduled time.
operations.saveSharedSkill: Save changes to a skill shared with the workspace, for everyone who uses it.
operations.saveSkill: Save changes to this skill's instructions.
operations.setAgentAssignments: Choose who may use this agent, and at what access level.
operations.setAgentModelChoice: Change which AI model this agent uses.
operations.setAgentSettings: Choose which apps and AI models this agent is allowed to use.
operations.setAgentTeam: Move this agent into another team in this space.
operations.setAgentTeamMemberOwner: Give someone ownership of this team, or take it away.
operations.setContext: Replace the background notes Houston gives the agent on every conversation.
operations.setOrgMemberRole: Change what this person is allowed to do in this space.
operations.submitCustomIntegrationCredential: Save the secret that finishes setting up this app.
operations.updateActivity: Update this mission's details or status.
operations.updateAgentTeam: Rename this team, reorder it, restyle it, or update the notes it shares.
operations.updateRoutine: Update this routine's schedule or instructions.
operations.writeAgentFile: Replace the contents of one of the agent's saved data files.
